entries.2c0f623ca2a284ef: Chain Operation of Nagasaki Champon Specialty Restaurants
entries.34bf2d733c09e51e: A business operating a chain of specialty restaurants serving Nagasaki Champon. It is run by Ringer Hut Japan Co., Ltd. and overseas consolidated subsidiaries, and as of February 28, 2026, the number of stores was 545 in Japan and 11 overseas, for a total of 556 stores (of which 136 are franchise stores). Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥36,881 million, the largest of the three businesses.

entries.d01962922df8771f: Store Facility Maintenance Work and Equipment Preservation
entries.dc240f78ecb03153: A business operating a chain of specialty restaurants serving tonkatsu. It is run by Hamakatsu Co., Ltd. and overseas consolidated subsidiaries, and as of February 28, 2026, the number of stores was 82 in Japan (including Nagasaki Shippoku Hamakatsu, a Japanese-cuisine format) and 3 overseas, for a total of 85 stores (of which 17 are franchise stores). Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥8,007 million.
entries.e0ba28ec9fb85c3d: A segment in which Ringer Foods Co., Ltd. mainly sells Ringer Hut brand products externally.
entries.f7a2b0d4d7a73396: A business in which Ringer Hut Kaihatsu Co., Ltd. mainly provides facility maintenance for the group's restaurant stores. The main activities are receiving orders for construction work to maintain facilities and preserving equipment at the group's company-operated stores and franchise stores. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥195 million.
